scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/types build && pnpm -C api build && pnpm -C ui build
scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/types build && pnpm -C api test && pnpm -C ui test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -C packages/types build && pnpm -C api test:coverage && pnpm -C ui test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:ci: pnpm -C packages/types build && pnpm -C api test:coverage:ci && pnpm -C ui test:coverage:ci
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/types build && pnpm -C api typecheck && pnpm -C ui typecheck
